steps.warmUp: Start with the warm-up, as in every singing lesson: a few easy minutes to wake up your voice.
steps.third: Major or minor? Only the third changes. Sing do, mi, sol in major, then the same with the lower third: you’ll hear the color change. In Ear training, you can now sing back intervals and short melodies too.
steps.chords: Do, mi, sol in major, then in minor. The music waits at each note.
steps.majorThenMinor: Listen, then sing it in time: five notes in major, then the same in minor.
steps.bothAlong: Major, then minor, singing along with the guide melody.
